text:
maria: heads-up — canary in eu-west failing during volume mount for redis creds after the recent values merge. pods crashing with `mountVolume` error.

deploy-bot: Canary paused for release v2.14.0 (eu-west) — reason: PodCrashLoopBackOff (mountVolume failed: secret "redis-credentials-eu" not found). @maria added a manual pause.

sam: yup, infra-configs PR #456 renamed the secret key to `redis-secret`. values.yaml now uses `redisSecretName: redis-secret` while older clusters expect `redis-credentials-eu`.

alex: confirmed. This is a values/schema drift — chart v2.14.0 expects the new name. Two quick options:
- pin the canary to chart v2.13.9 (safe, quick rollback)
- hotfix the values for eu-west to set `redisSecretName: redis-credentials-eu` and resume canary

maria: hotfix preferred if it's low-risk. But the DB migration job reads creds at startup; if we hotfix, we must ensure the migration won't run twice. If we pin, we avoid touching migrations.

release-coordinator: proposal: manual pin for eu-west canary to v2.13.9 for 1 hour, open release ticket to fix values and test in staging, then promote fixed chart and unpin. Steps:
1) pin release in eu-west: set chart version 2.13.9 and resume canary
2) create a feature branch to add backwards-compatible `redisSecretName` fallback
3) run staging canary with patched values and confirm
4) promote and unpin

sam: fine with that. I'll craft the fallback values patch:

```
# values.yaml override for eu-west
redisSecretName: {{ default "redis-credentials-eu" .Values.redisSecretName }}
```

alex: for the pin I will run the manual helm upgrade in eu-west canary pool:

```
helm upgrade myapp ./chart --namespace prod-eu-west --set image.tag=sha256:abcd1234 --version 2.13.9 --reuse-values
```

maria: after pin, I'll resume canary and watch for health probes for 10m. If anything else fails, we roll back to previous image and alert SRE.

deploy-bot: Manual intervention recorded by alex. Canary remains paused until `resume` command. Use `/deploy resume v2.13.9 eu-west` to continue when ready.

release-coordinator: I'll open a follow-up: REL-1024 "values fallback for redis secret name" and assign to sam. Target: patch on Monday, test in staging, unpin by Tue morning.

sam: assigned and noted in REL-1024. Will include unit test for values rendering.

maria: ack. resuming once pinned.

alex: /deploy resume v2.13.9 eu-west — kicking it off now :rocket: 

deploy-bot: Canary resumed. 10 pods scheduled across 2 nodes. Monitoring health for 15m.

maria: seeing stable pods, no mount errors. looks good. thanks y'all :thumbsup: 

alex: leaving a quick note in release notes: "eu-west canary temporarily pinned to chart 2.13.9 due to secret-name mismatch; values fix pending (REL-1024)."

maria: perfect — closing this thread when REL-1024 has a PR.

sam: will post PR link here once ready.

alex: thanks, team.
